description: Save (or update, with id) a recipe in the signed-in baker's Foods Recipes library. Ingredient costs are the baker's own package costs — never invent prices. First saved recipe is free; the library beyond that is Cottage Pro (same rule as the dashboard). Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

allergens.description: Allergen names as the baker states them

id.description: Existing recipe id to update (from get_my_dashboard or a previous save)

ingredients.description: Ingredients with the baker's entered package costs

usedQty.description: Quantity used per batch, same unit

name.description: Recipe name, e.g. Sourdough sandwich loaf

name: save_recipe
title: Save a dashboard recipe
